grammar.summary: 本课综合运用过去进行时与一般过去时叙事。

points.title: 叙事中的时态配合
points.explanation: 故事背景用过去进行时铺垫（It was raining），情节推进用一般过去时（saw, went, ran）。when/while 引导时间从句。

examples.en: One afternoon, she was sitting by the river.
examples.cn: 一天下午，她正坐在河边。

points.title: so...that 结果状语（初步感知）
points.explanation: The snake was so frightened that it... so + 形容词 + that + 结果句，表"如此……以至于"。

examples.en: She was so frightened that she ran away.
